author: TheColdCrafter
body:
Staff Members Username: _DISTRACTION_

Reason of complaint: Falsely tempbanning me and refusing to provide any evidence or respond to appeal.
Explanation (of what he/she is doing wrong): Will not give me evidence or acknowledge what he did, And is simply going to wait until my ban expiree to close my appeal, and people heard what he said.

Evidence: After I left the teamspeak channel, shortly after my tempban, Junr heard him say "I'm just gonna wait until his ban expires to close his appeal." ALM, Kashike, SSuperLLion and others were also in the teamspeak channel when he said this. I believe that this is abusing his power as a moderator, and he is also lying about having evidence of it, because he knows he is in the wrong, and he doesn't have any real evidence.
